text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe finally arrived. Victoire Pisa 
was responding to interviews.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—I will give it my absolute all tomorrow, 
so please, watch over me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you're totally calm. It looks 
like you won't have any issues with 
fatigue from traveling or the new 
environment...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm in top condition. Thank you for 
your concern.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I promise to make it a great race. The 
kind of amazing race that puts a smile on 
everyone's face...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
—Pisa-san! I watched the press conference! 
Seeing you act like your usual self was 
such a relief. I believe you're definitely 
going to win!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. To think you came all 
this way to such a distant place just to 
cheer for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hotter a star gets, the whiter and 
bluer it shines. I suddenly remembered 
that fact.
choice_data_list:
Pisa... You seem a little different than 
usual, huh?

Pisa... You seem a little different than 
usual, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Does it look that way to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I might be overthinking it. Even so, I 
want to hear her thoughts properly before 
the race...
choice_data_list: Want to walk and talk for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—We really have come so far. And yet, the 
sky is the exact same color as back in 
Japan...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No, it connects people all across the 
world, doesn't it? Just like that... 
tomorrow, I will also..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa stares into the distance 
with determined eyes. As expected, her 
heart is...
choice_data_list: You're fired up, aren't you, Pisa...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's burning... burning so very 
passionately.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't bring it up at the press 
conference, but my feelings haven't 
changed since back then.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Through my victory, I want to connect the 
circles of the world.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So that everyone can share in the joy. So 
that it can become a reason to join hands 
together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ......Yes. That is, after all, my wish...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*... ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for listening. Somehow, it's 
gotten me all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over me. I promise I'll bring 
home the win—!
